subject: delta(client): WF record the effect fence and journal commits, choose the merged blobs and move the record anchor to the merge
note: Both sides of the merge recorded the durable journal and the entry-point closure helper; this record chooses the merged copies, which keep every change of both sides. Both sides also changed the README; its merged copy keeps both sides' lines and is named so the anchored README keeps a record after the anchor. The commit also records the two merged commits that changed the package as record files and moves the anchor to the merge, so the anchored files start from their merged copies.
